checks.name: Independent spatial holdout excluded from fitting
Exact smooth worst-position risk is used

listening_area.name: Three-seat row / centre priority
listening_area.notice: Seat priorities are divided among measured points within each seat; repeated scans do not multiply seat priority. Missing seats remain unmeasured and prevent final row-wide correction.

joint_optimization.notice: All native FIR taps and observation cross terms are retained. Annular magnitude constraints are nonconvex; numerical convergence is not global optimality or hardware validation.
joint_optimization.native_realization_notice: Expanded FIR taps are not independent native DSP parameters. XT32 coefficient compression and actual synthesis require a supplied validated model; this is a full-FIR reference candidate, not proof of native realizability.

notice: An abstract deterministic fixture, not measurements of the user's row. Feasibility, exact-risk computation and held-out evaluation are separate from numerical convergence and hardware validation.
